_comment: Both products are INVENTED. Mining and publishing a real company's reviews in a public repo means making claims about a real product, and this project is about the analysis, not about any actual app. Swap in a CSV of real reviews to use it for real work.

reviews.text: Bank sync broke again this week. Third time this month I've had to reconnect my checking account. Support was lovely about it but that's not the point.
The connection to my credit union drops constantly. Everything else about this app is good which makes it more frustrating.
Sync issues with my bank started around June. Was rock solid before that.
Reconnecting accounts every few days is exhausting. Please fix the sync.
Customer support is genuinely the best I have dealt with in any app. Real person, replied in an hour, fixed it.
Emailed support on a Sunday and got a real answer Monday morning. Rare these days.
Support team is excellent. They walked me through the goal setup on a call.
Whoever runs their support deserves a raise. Patient and actually knowledgeable.
I still don't understand what I'm being charged. The fee page mentions a percentage but my statement shows something else.
Fees are not clearly explained anywhere. Had to email to find out what I actually pay.
Took me twenty minutes to work out the fee structure. Should be one sentence.

Slow. Especially the transactions screen with a lot of history.

The goal tracking is the reason I stay. Set a house down payment goal and it actually keeps me honest.
Goals feature is excellent. Visual, simple, motivating.
Love being able to set multiple savings goals and see progress on one screen.
The goal projections are the best I've seen in this category.
Solid app overall. Does what it says.

Clean and simple. Doesn't try to do too much.
